You must answer on the enclosed answer booklet.
You will need: Answer booklet (enclosed)
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
Follow the instructions on the front cover of the answer booklet. If you need additional answer paper,
ask the invigilator for a continuation booklet.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–18
1 How important were the actions of Haig to the course of the war? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant were domestic problems as a cause of the German Revolution in October 1918?
Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–45
How important were Stresemann’s foreign policy achievements in stabilising Weimar Germany by
1929? Explain your answer.
How significant was Hindenburg in Hitler’s takeover of Germany between 1933 and 1934? Explain
your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–41
How important were military defeats in weakening the Tsar’s control in Russia by March 1917?
Explain your answer. [40]
How significant were the Five-Year Plans in helping Stalin increase his control of the Soviet Union?
Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY D: THE UNITED STATES, 1919–41
How important was the support of politicians and industrialists as a reason for the introduction of
Prohibition in the USA? Explain your answer.
How significant was the Republican Party in the opposition to the New Deal? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important was control of the media in maintaining Mao’s dictatorship? Explain your answer.
How significant was the death of Mao in bringing change to the Chinese economy? Explain your
answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
How important was government repression in maintaining white minority control in South Africa
after 1948? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was unrest in the townships in bringing about an end to white minority rule in South
Africa? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How important was the Six-Day War as a cause of the Yom Kippur War? Explain your answer.
How significant was Hezbollah as a reason for the breakdown of relations between Israelis and
Palestinians? Explain your answer. [40]
